title: Paulie (film)
blurb: A talking blue-crowned conure who narrates his own life story — and his long search for the girl who raised him — to a night janitor in the 1998 film Paulie.
facts: It stars Jay Mohr as the voice of the title character, alongside Gena Rowlands, Tony Shalhoub, Cheech Marin, and Bruce Davison.
Paulie was the first collaboration between Rowlands and Cobbs.
